translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: 1 TIMOTI
book.title: 1 TIMOTI Pol ere Timoti erne kiyi bas rasem siglou.

content: Nema God eterken tuma namdete, ere tatame nogwape emne kobo late.

An nene wobe tuma gwo. Taresin yite tuma, kem tatame nogwape emne abon God eterken kwokwos kwokwos namdebet. Kem erne wometbetete, ere tatame emne kobo labet. Kem nowselri keryenken gavman tameken emne abon God erne etemne wometbet. Kem emne abon God erne pir wobet. Kem etep nente, nema noub me temente. Nema ei beke nai, nema noub site. Nema God erne abote, nema eteri wule noub tobote.
Ete wule e yenbo. Nema etep nente, Neremne Sene Petbe Keryen God ere nemne metekwasbe.
Ere akeite tatame emne sene pette abobe. Eme eteri tuma seken noub mette, ere etep abobe.
Tatame etemne sene petbe tame wurisubu tetan. Ere Keryen God. God eri tatame etemri borke tetan apeilake wurisubuwai tetan. Ete tame ere Krais Jisas eter.
God eri kiyi wom yabelke Krais ere eteri wusom beke abo, ere akei tatame etemri wule yaper tuken sam. Etep nenem, nema metten, God ere tatame etemne sene pette abobe.

Etepkap, God ere ane ete tuma wusoute wom. Ere ane aposel yaku newom. An tuma seken wobe, an kemne beke yikwokwo. Juda berai tatame eme God eteri tuma seken noub meten erne kenawaike abote, eke an God eteri tuma etemne wusoube.
An abobe, nogwape komri Kristen tatame eme God eterken tuma namdebet. Ete tatame eme wule yenbowai nente. Eme pap mane wayete. Eme ei mane naite. Etep nente, eme God eterken noub namdete.

An Kristen ta emne wobe. Eme selpap yenbo ten tame oub yenbo warte. Eme tame oub mane waren aste. Eme tame oub yaper warte, oknal nerewarbe, e yaper. Eme kel eisauke tukbe tame oub, nikel wankel mane tuken wolete.
God erne kenawaike abobe ta eme epkap epkap wule yenbo noub nente. Etep nentek, e etemri kerap yenbokap.
Ta eme porere pekate, eme maime teitkwunen elen me sin tuma noub mette.
An ta emne wotakebe. Eme tame emne God eteri tuma mane wusoute, emne mane teitkwunte. Eme elen me sin wan taite.
Beke an etep wobe? God ere Adam erne kiyi seikim, yurik ere Iv tene seikim. Eke an etep wobe.
Adam ere yikwokwo tuma worwor beke met. Iv etet, te Satan eri tuma worwor metem, te God eteri wule tousim.

Tousim, eke ta eme yen warwibe, eme mus eisau metbe. Ta eme Krais erne kenawaike som abobetete, eme elen me sin tatame emne wule yenbo som nenbetete, eme wule yenbowou som nenbetete, ete ta eme yen warwite, God ere emne kobo lan sene pette, eme yenbo tete nenbe.
